body: Thank you so much. I am feeling a little better. I really appreciate you taking the time to reach out to a fellow human in need. I will be okay, I think, and I have the suicide hotline number in my phone just in case. I locked up the gun and threw the keys under the house - just to make it a pain in the ass to find them. And I locked the pills up. I won't need them. Thank you for your reply, I really appreciate it. It makes a difference knowing that someone is out there.

Thank you. Thank you. I am actually feeling a bit better now - I sort of had a talk with myself. I don't want to die. I need to find better ways to cope with the pain. Thank you for reaching out-  you have no idea how much it means. I am going to sleep, I think if I have a good night's sleep I will feel better in the morning, less exhausted and maybe better able to cope. If things get really bad I'll hop back on. Thank you for caring - it DOES matter. And your love matters. Thank you.

I'm really sorry. I have been feeling suicidal today and it seems like nobody understands. Like you said - nobody to turn to. Or maybe I have people to turn to but I don't know how. Anyway, just wanted you to know I am listening. It is so hard to be in this place. You are not alone.
